item.title: Taint Analysis for Agent Tool Calls
item.description:
Author: Steven Jung
Date: N/A
Tags: ["AI Security", "Static Code Analysis", "Data Flow Analysis", "Software Development", "Machine Learning"]
Summary:
  • AI agents use multiple tools chained together.
  • Taint analysis tracks data flow between these tools.
  • Tools are categorized as private sources, untrusted sources, or state-changing sinks.
  • Risks include data leaks and tampering.
  • Signals like schema overlap and runtime analysis help identify risky chains.
  • This approach improves security for AI-driven workflows.

item.title: Latest Research 98% Accurate and Still Broken
item.description:
Author: Steven Jung
Date: January 03, 2026
Tags: ["Machine Learning", "Prompt Injection Detection", "Natural Language Processing", "Security", "Large Language Models"]
Summary:
  • A ModernBERT classifier achieved 98% accuracy in prompt injection detection.
  • However, it struggles with novel attack patterns.
  • Embedding-based methods improve generalization but add latency.
  • Small language models detect new attacks better but are slower.
  • Large LLMs used zero-shot show the best detection but are impractical for real-time use.
